_readme: Every real-world number in the game. Owner: K1. Each number is an entry {value, unit, src, verified}. src is the URL the value was read from; "game: ..." marks a game rule or design option; "PLACEHOLDER" means not researched yet, and then value must be null: no estimates. note says how the source states it.

cause.value: A severe Mars-wide dust storm blanketed its location and starved the solar panels.
Stuck in soft soil at "Troy"; the most probable cause of the loss was excessive cold that made its survival heaters ineffective.
Seasonal decline in sunshine left too little light for the solar arrays; orbital images suggest a panel probably collapsed under winter ice.
cause.note: panel collapse is inferred ("scientists believe"), not confirmed
